crossRefs.note: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first…
Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become…
If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save…
It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not…
But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from…

translations.web: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
translations.bsb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
translations.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
translations.asv: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you: howbeit he that sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these speak I unto the world.
